title: SVCCTL: Update idl for GetServiceDisplayNameW and GetServiceKeyNameW
description:
Update the idl for GetServiceDisplayNameW and GetServiceKeyNameW to
match [MS-SCMR]:

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-scmr/48b42c4a-26b7-4d59-9b7a-98533ebeb730
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-scmr/ecd403db-cc75-4402-a5fc-fcda46106205
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-scmr/19168537-40b5-4d7a-99e0-d77f0f5e0241

This does cause pidl to warn:
svcctl.idl:445: warning: [out] argument `display_name' not a pointer
svcctl.idl:454: warning: [out] argument `service_name' not a pointer

But causes the sample capture to dissect correctly.

Fix #20765
